jobs.title: Research associate: AI
jobs.company: Stift The Stockholm Environment Institute, Sei
jobs.description:
The role combines hands-on evidence synthesis with the development and evaluation of AI-driven approaches to make evidence synthesis processes more efficient. You will work on manual evidence-synthesis tasks, while also using Python and/or R to build and validate machine learning, automation and AI-assisted workflows for searching, eligibility screening, and (meta)data extraction. Your work will also contribute to new meta-research on how, and under what conditions, automated and AI-based tools can speed up and improve evidence synthesis in the environmental field without compromising reliability, robustness or scientific quality.
Our team spans many disciplines and we welcome candidates from different backgrounds. If you have strong research and programming skills, want to help connect sustainability science with policymaking and are keen to learn evidence synthesis methods, we would like to hear from you.
Key tasks and responsibilities
Conduct and support manual literature searching, screening and (meta)data extraction for evidence synthesis projects, working with large volumes of scientific publications and grey literature (including bibliographic information and textual data).
Develop and maintain reproducible workflows in Python and/or R for screening, extraction, classification, quality-checking, cleaning and harmonization of textual and bibliographic data.
Apply and evaluate machine learning, natural language processing and LLM-based methods for text classification, information extraction and document analysis.
Validate automated and AI-generated outputs against human decisions, quantifying errors, uncertainty and potential biases.
Document methods, decisions and validation procedures to support transparent and reproducible research.
Work collaboratively with researchers across environmental, sustainability, climate, energy and social science.
Who you are
You are an early-career researcher with strong analytical and programming skills who enjoys working where sustainability research meets technology development – engaging with both the details of evidence synthesis and the computational methods that support it.
You are happy to do detailed manual eligibility screening and (meta) data extraction, while looking for opportunities to automate these processes and make them more efficient.
You have a background in, or strong interest in, sustainability or environmental research and enjoy learning from people with different disciplinary backgrounds.
You do not need to be an expert in every method or technology used in this role. We value someone who is curious, careful, quick to learn and a constructive team player.
The role would suit someone with:
Programming and data analysis skills in Python and/or R, including version control with GitHub
Experience handling large volumes of structured and unstructured text
Practical experience applying machine learning, NLP or large language models to text classification, information extraction or eligibility screening
An interest in evidence synthesis methodology
Knowledge of, or interest in, sustainability or environmental research

Experience with more advanced AI development, such as model fine-tuning or deployment, is welcome but deep expertise in machine learning or software engineering is not required.
Experience with any of the following is highly desirable, but not required:
Literature reviews, including systematic, scoping and rapid reviews
Working with bibliographic datasets
Literature eligibility screening or (meta)data extraction

Formal qualifications
A master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, socio-environmental science, sustainability science or a related field.
Early-career experience (1–2 years) in academic or applied research involving data analysis and AI/data-driven methods.

Personal skills
Collaborative: comfortable working in teams and across disciplinary boundaries.
Analytical and critical: able to assess evidence and critically evaluate AI-generated results.
Systematic and data-oriented: enjoys turning complex information into reliable datasets.
Clear communicator: able to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Curious and adaptable: interested in learning and applying rapidly developing AI methods.
Quality-focused and responsible: attentive to research integrity, transparency, uncertainty and AI-related risks.

Additional information
You will join the International Climate Risk and Adaptation Team, which develops and applies pioneering research methods to define, describe, measure and communicate systemic climate risk in interdependent global systems. Drawing on diverse perspectives, its work spans quantitative and qualitative analysis, climate risk assessment, scenario and foresight development and AI-driven policy analysis.
Our offer
At SEI HQ we offer a stimulating position in an international environment. You will be part of a leading, multinational, multidisciplinary and multilingual team of experts in an organization where the well-being and development of our employees is of high priority. We value diversity and creativity at the core of what we do and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply. Our ambition is to provide a safe, professional, and creative workspace for all.
An employment with SEI HQ includes:
Collective Agreement incl. occupational pension and many other collectively agreed benefits
An annual healthcare contribution and additional benefits connected to promoting our employees’ wellbeing such as yearly health check-ups
Opportunities for professional growth and development
Flexible working hours, 37.5-hour workweek and a generous amount of vacation days
Being part of tackling environmental and development challenges and developing solutions for a sustainable future for all.

Once employed, you must live in Sweden, preferably in the Stockholm area. It is not possible to work from another country.


How to apply
We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than 26 October 2026, 23:59 Stockholm local time.
Applications must be written in English and submitted through our recruitment system. Please include:
Cover letter highlighting relevant qualifications and experience (no more than two pages)
Curriculum vitae (no more than four pages)

Please note that we screen all applicants manually. Incomplete applications will not be accepted.

jobs.title: AI Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Backend Engineer to build the core intelligence layer of a fast-scaling AI company backed by NVIDIA, Microsoft, and AWS.
About Antrino
Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent.
The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, machines idle, space goes unused, and decisions about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there, as structured, real-time information it can act on. Not a research project or a custom integration, but a platform where you describe what matters and deploy it.
We have grown from 6 people to a team of 28 in less than a year, closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and are registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP), the Swedish authority for strategic and dual-use products. Everything we build follows Privacy by Design.
The role
You will build the services that turn a customer's intent into working intelligence.
When a customer builds something in Studio, our composition canvas, that graph has to become a running system: a plan that decides which models to call, in what order, gated by cost and confidence, and that produces events and evidence a customer can trust. You will work on the compiler that turns the graph into an execution plan, the runtime that executes it, and the Python and TypeScript services that detection, classification, and measurement run through.
You will also work on our Agent, which interviews customers, proposes and edits these graphs, and deploys them with confirmation. Getting an LLM to reliably manipulate a structured graph, validate it, and explain its reasoning is a real engineering problem, not a prompting exercise.
The role sits between the team building our first-party detection models and the engineers building the product interface. It is backend systems engineering for a product whose core logic is built out of AI calls.
What you will work on
Backend services for detection, classification, and measurement, largely in Python with FastAPI
The compiler that turns a Studio graph into an execution plan, and the runtime that deploys and runs it
Routing logic that decides which model handles which work, including cost gating where a cheap model decides when an expensive one runs
The Agent's interview, graph-editing, and deployment flows that turn natural language into a working pipeline
Integrating our first-party detection models, and frontier model APIs where they do something ours do not yet, behind one clean interface
Turning raw model output into structured, auditable events and evidence an operator can trust
APIs and data models for streams, behaviors, runs, and events in PostgreSQL with row-level security
Tests and evaluation harnesses for logic that includes non-deterministic model calls
Debugging production issues that span a customer request, our orchestration, and the model call underneath



Our stack
You do not need experience with all of this, but you should recognize most of it and be able to argue about it.
Backend: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Node.jsData: PostgreSQL through Supabase, with row-level security, 
Streaming: RTSP ingestion, RTSP→HLS conversion, live and archive pipelines
Infrastructure: Azure, GitHub Actions, on-site compute reached over Tailscale
Who we are looking for Substantial backend experience on production systems, ideally where an LLM or ML model was part of the core logic rather than a bolted-on feature
Strong Python, and comfort in TypeScript or Node.js
Real experience designing APIs, data models, and service boundaries, including PostgreSQL
Experience building with LLM APIs beyond a chat wrapper: tool use, structured output, agentic flows, or a model as one step in a larger pipeline
An understanding of how to test systems with non-deterministic components
Experience with real-time or streaming data is a strong advantage
Excellent written and spoken English. Swedish is a plus, not a requirement



You can reason about a graph or compiler-shaped problem even if you have never built a compiler. You make decisions with incomplete information, take responsibility for the outcome, and say so clearly when something you built was wrong.
Life at Antrino
You will join a team of driven, ambitious people who thrive at a fast pace and enjoy working together. We go to AI events, host our own, and end plenty of weeks with an afterwork. You will work closely with our engineers in Stockholm and our growing team in Bangalore.
What we offer
Direct access to the founders, the engineering team, and customers
Real ownership of a core layer of the platform rather than delegated tickets
Potential participation in our stock option programme after the probationary period
Hardware of your choice
AI events, afterworks, team activities, and travel when the business requires it
Occupational pension, insurance, and friskvårdsbidrag



Process
Introductory conversation about your background and the role
Technical conversation about systems you have built and why you made the decisions you made. No whiteboard algorithm puzzles
Working session with the engineering team on a real problem from our stack
Conversation with the founders about options and terms



We review applications continuously. References may be requested at the final stage.
Apply with your CV and, if you have one, a link to something you have built. A repository, a shipped product, or a short note about a system you are proud of tells us more than a cover letter

Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
The Role
 As Etraveli Group rapidly expands its agentic AI ecosystem, we are looking for a hands-on engineer to serve as the core technical muscle for our AI Optimization team. In this role, you will rapidly build, test, and evaluate agentic MVPs using Python, APIs, and LLM frameworks. You will design rigorous evaluation pipelines to prove accuracy, latency, and ROI, ensuring all agents align with company principles. Once validated, you will act as the key technical stakeholder translating prototypes into clean specifications for our core Technology team to scale.
Responsibilities

Build functional end-to-end agents using Python, LLM frameworks, APIs, and databases.
Spin up infrastructure (vector/relational databases, docker containers) for real-world testing.
Select architectural patterns (API wrappers, lightweight RAG, function calling).
Iterate based on business feedback and discard when concepts prove unviable.



Data Rigor & Technical Evaluation
Design evaluation pipelines to benchmark accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost.
Build ground-truth labeled evaluation sets with business owners to validate production readiness.
Analyze discrepancies between agent outputs and human decisions during pilots.
Support business stakeholders in taking responsibility for prompts and business logic.
Continuously test new AI models and tools against internal benchmarks.



Feasibility & Technical Discovery
Assess operational workflows with strategy teams to determine agentic feasibility and scope difficulty.
Evaluate new agent architectures and AI tooling to recommend core platform adoption.



Handoff & Platform Stakeholder
Serve as the primary technical stakeholder to the core technology AI platform team.
Translate validated MVPs into clear technical specs, architecture diagrams, and data flows.
Partner with AI platform team to ensure seamless absorption of MVP logic into internal SDKs.

Must Have
3+ years software engineering experience with strong Python and rapid prototyping skills.
Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration (tool use, RAG, structured outputs via LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or APIs).
Proficiency in API design, SQL, and relational/vector databases.
Experience using evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith) to benchmark performance.
Agile, pragmatic mindset for fast experimentation outside traditional sprint cycles.
Ability to convert complex business logic into concise specs for engineering teams.

Background as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar fast-delivery role.
Familiarity with modern deployment stacks (FastAPI, Docker, serverless).
Domain experience in travel tech, airline distribution, or payments.
Basic product management understanding (ROI tracking, KPIs, user validation).

The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy:
A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Medical Image Analysis
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

RaySearch is looking for a machine learning engineer with strong experience in medical image analysis to join our ML Imaging team in Stockholm. You will develop deep learning algorithms for medical image analysis in RayStation, our radiotherapy treatment planning system, helping clinical teams deliver effective cancer treatments. RayStation is used at more than 1,000 cancer clinics in more than 50 countries.

**About the role**
==================

You will develop machine learning models for use in clinical practice, working on medical image segmentation, synthetic CT generation, image registration, and other medical imaging applications.

Working closely with internal clinical specialists and external partner clinics, you will translate clinical needs into methods and models and evaluate their performance. You will also collaborate with regulatory and quality experts to ensure that algorithms are developed, validated, and documented in accordance with applicable medical device requirements.

**You will**
------------

* Develop and evaluate deep learning algorithms for medical imaging using Python and PyTorch.
* Prepare and curate clinical imaging datasets, configure and run model training, and maintain reproducible training workflows.
* Review relevant research and assess the suitability of methods for clinical applications.
* Design experiments and evaluate model performance using appropriate quantitative measures and clinical acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with clinical experts and external clinics on development and validation.
* Contribute to the testing and documentation required for medical device software.

**Your profile**
================

You have strong experience in medical image analysis. You enjoy investigating problems, testing ideas, and turning promising methods into machine learning models. You take ownership of your work, can plan and carry out development independently, and know when to involve colleagues. You value collaboration, careful evaluation, and clear documentation, and are motivated by improving cancer care.

**Requirements**
----------------

* A PhD or master’s degree in computer science, machine learning, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related field.
* At least four years of relevant experience in machine learning or medical image analysis, gained through research or industry, including doctoral research.
* Extensive experience developing and evaluating deep learning models for medical image analysis.
* A strong understanding of deep learning, computer vision, statistics, and applied mathematics.
* Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch.
* Familiarity with software engineering practices, including version control, testing, and code reviews.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English.

**Meriting**
------------

* Experience with 3D medical imaging, particularly CT, MR, or CBCT.
* Experience with one or more of medical image segmentation, image registration, or image synthesis.
* Experience developing and validating medical device software or other regulated software.
* Experience with tools for experiment tracking, data versioning, and reproducible training workflows.

**Our Culture**
===============

At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.

**Our Offer**
=============

We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

**Application**
===============

Please apply for the position through the application form below. Selection and interviews will be ongoing. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

jobs.title: AI Researcher
jobs.description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About the opportunity**

Join Ericsson Research and help shape the future of connectivity. AI is central to Ericsson’s 6G vision, enabling intelligent, sustainable, and secure networks for people and industries in the 2030s and beyond. Our work combines machine learning, advanced reasoning, and real network systems, with access to live network data and opportunities to influence global standards and technologies used worldwide.

This early-career role suits a recent master’s graduate or someone with a few years of experience in AI/ML. You’ll take on meaningful research from day one, collaborate with global, cross-disciplinary teams, and learn from experienced mentors. A telecom degree or prior radio expertise isn’t required: you can build domain knowledge through hands-on work with radio specialists. We value diverse perspectives and offer an inclusive environment, flexible ways of working, wellbeing support, benefits, and growth opportunities. You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification; curiosity and motivation matter.

**What you will do**

* Research, design, and evaluate AI/ML concepts for future radio access networks and AI-native systems, including autonomous, large-scale telecom networks.
* Develop algorithms, models, and simulation frameworks. Explore AI applications in radio access networks.
* Use modern AI-assisted development tools to prototype and iterate quickly.
* Collaborate with experts in radio systems, networking, and hardware, connecting research ideas with practical needs such as performance, scalability, robustness, automation and energy efficiency.
* Turn research into prototypes, publications, patents, and contributions to future standards. Share findings, build your research profile, and keep learning with support from senior researchers.

**Skills you bring**

* An MSc in AI, data science, computer science, engineering physics, robotics, or a closely related field is preferred. Candidates with an MSc and strong AI research experience are also encouraged to apply.
* A strong foundation in modern AI, such as deep, reinforcement, or distributed learning; generative AI; probabilistic modelling; stochastic optimization; or graph-based methods.
* Python programming skills and familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.
* Some experience designing, training, or validating ML-driven systems through studies, internships, or personal projects. Familiarity with simulation-based evaluation is valuable.
* Interest in AI coding assistants and openness to new tools. Experience with Docker or Kubernetes is a plus.
* Interest in telecommunications, networking, or signal processing. Telecom expertise can be learned on the job.

At the Group Driving Performance & Aero, we hold the responsibility for the core feature of Energy Economy, Driving Range, CO2/GHG Emissions, Drivability, Average Speed and Aerodynamic AirDrag testing. The challenge 
Volvo Group certifies aerodynamic drag (CdA) for heavy-duty trucks under EU VECTO regulations through physical testing at proving grounds. We have accumulated a substantial dataset of CdA measurements paired with detailed weather data and logged continuous signals. The aim is to push our understanding further by investigating how much of the test spread and test-to-test variation is driven by environmental conditions.

Your task is to analyze the data and investigate the physical mechanisms behind CdA variation, due to transient effects for instance. 
 
The work includes:  
Statistical analysis of CdA variation against environmental variables across multiple proving grounds 
Segment-by-segment signal analysis within individual test runs to identify transient effects that run-averaged data masks 
Decomposing CdA scatter into aerodynamic environmental effects, and non-aerodynamic confounders, and unexplained residual 
Cross-referencing findings with an existing ML correlation and prediction model

We’re building Lucy, an AI system that investigates marketing performance and carries approved changes through to execution.
Behind that work is a backend coordinating model calls, external APIs, persistent state, and code running in sandboxes. We’re a small team in Stockholm building the infrastructure this product needs.


The Problem
Agent workloads are difficult to predict. One request can become several parallel investigations. A task can pause for approval and continue later. A worker can disappear after an external API accepts a change but before the result is saved.
Retrying may duplicate the action. Giving up may leave the work unfinished. Keeping everything ready reduces latency but consumes idle compute.
The system has to know what happened, who owns the next step, and what is safe to repeat—while keeping data isolated and costs under control.


The Role
You’ll own the execution infrastructure, data systems, and reliability behind Lucy.
You’ll work across application code, databases, and cloud infrastructure, taking changes from design through deployment and operation. Your decisions will shape how the product handles more work and recovers when things fail.


What You’ll Do
Make execution durable. Build scheduling, queues, leases, cancellation, and recovery for work that outlives an individual request.
Make retries safe. Preserve execution state and prevent duplicate events from repeating external actions.
Run agent compute efficiently. Improve sandbox startup, worker scaling, resource limits, and cleanup.
Build dependable data flows. Handle pagination, partial failures, changing provider contracts, and datasets that should be streamed rather than held in memory.
Make failures explainable. Connect traces, logs, and cost data so the team can find bottlenecks and resolve incidents.

What We’re Looking For
You’ve operated backend systems in production and owned their reliability. You understand database design, distributed state, queues, and the difference between a failed request and a failed operation.
You’re comfortable with containers and cloud infrastructure. You can explain what breaks under load, how recovery works, and when a simpler design is enough.
Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, Cloud Run, GKE, Modal, Docker, and Pulumi.

jobs.title: Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
Rebaba is building circular battery systems from second-life EV batteries. Our products power buildings, industries, and charging infrastructure while reducing costs and emissions. We design and assemble our systems in Sweden and combine hardware, embedded software, and cloud control into one integrated platform.
We are now hiring a Certification Engineer to build and own our certification process from the ground up, making sure everything we design, build, and ship meets the standards, directives, and safety requirements. You will shape how Rebaba certifies BESS systems today and become one of the few real experts in the world in certifying second-life BESS. If you want to go deep on real electrical systems, own a process end to end, and become a genuine expert in a field that barely exists yet, we would love to hear from you.
As Certification Engineer at Rebaba you will own the full certification process for our BESS products, from reading and interpreting the applicable directives and standards, to defining what needs to be tested and how, to producing the technical documentation that proves it. This is a hands-on role that sits between engineering, quality, and delivery. You will work closely with our engineering team and external certification partners, and over time become the internal and external authority on what it takes to certify second-life battery systems for European markets.
Responsibilities
Build, own, and continuously improve Rebaba's certification process for BESS products, covering LVD, EMC, and the EU Battery Regulation
Interpret and apply the standards, directives, and regulations governing battery systems, electrical safety, EMC, and enclosures (e.g. IEC 62619, IEC 62933, UN 38.3, CE marking, the Low Voltage and EMC Directives, RoHS), and determine which requirements are applicable to our specific product design
Translate standards and customer, grid, and safety requirements into clear, traceable technical requirements for the engineering teams, and maintain requirements traceability across product development
Define what tests need to be run, how, and against which acceptance criteria, based on the relevant standards
Plan and manage compliance and certification activities as projects - scope, timeline, testing, documentation, and sign-off
Coordinate and align certification processes with notified bodies, test labs, and external partners; select and manage external test labs
Own technical compliance documentation, including declarations of conformity, technical files, risk assessments, and test reports, ensuring every compliance claim is traceable to a primary source
Lead product safety, hazard, and risk analyses for our battery systems
Track open regulatory and standard-interpretation questions, escalate where needed, and drive them to closure
Work closely with electronics, mechanical, software, and quality teams to build compliance into the design from the start
Keep Rebaba ahead of evolving standards and regulatory requirements in energy storage, and feed changes back into the product
Lay the path for how certification scales as Rebaba expands into new products and markets

Requirements
Experience with power electronics and electrical systems in one or more of: UPS systems, PV inverters, LV switchgear, EV charging infrastructure, motor drives/VFDs, EV battery packs, or stationary battery/backup power systems
Solid understanding of core electrical concepts relevant to BESS: insulation coordination, DC/DC or DC/AC power conversion, contactor/switching logic, short-circuit protection
Comfortable reading and working directly with electrical schematics and system architecture, not just specifications
Well-versed and structured in requirements analysis and requirements management
Comfortable working across electronics, mechanical, and software teams and translating between them
You are exceptionally rigorous and precise, read regulations and standards carefully and literally
You have the patience to trace every claim back to its source, and the discipline to keep detailed, structured records over long-running projects
Professional English; Swedish is a plus
You thrive in an entrepreneurial environment with fast decision cycles and high autonomy
You are excited about clean energy and want to build something you believe in

Meriting
Prior experience with product certification, CE marking, or regulatory compliance
Experience with IEC 62933, IEC 62477-1, IEC 61439-1, IEC 62619, or IEC 60664-1
Background in battery chemistry, EV batteries, or second-life applications
Prior direct contact with notified bodies or testing laboratories
Experience with gap analysis or risk tracking in technical/regulatory projects

Benefits
Own certification end to end, in a field where the playbook is still being written
Become one of the few real experts in certifying second-life BESS, in Europe or anywhere
Close collaboration with a small, hands-on engineering team
A mission-driven company focused on sustainable energy solutions
A clear path to grow as Rebaba scales - in seniority, responsibility, and scope

About Rebaba
Rebaba is at the forefront of sustainable energy storage solutions. We specialize in giving second life to electric vehicle batteries, transforming them into efficient energy storage systems. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to renewable energy while reducing waste and environmental impact.

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.


Role Summary
As an Industrial Engineer, you will play a key role in a smaller production unit where your work has a direct impact on our business. With short decision-making paths, your ideas can quickly become tangible improvements.
You will be an important part of our production engineering development, with the opportunity to take ideas and analyses all the way through to implemented solutions that make a measurable difference. The role offers a high degree of ownership and the opportunity to influence our technology, ways of working and business results. You will work closely with production, maintenance and external suppliers, playing a central role in ensuring robust, efficient and future-proof technical solutions.
We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and levels of experience—whether you are at the beginning of your career or bring several years of industry experience.
Job Responsibilities
As a Industrial Engineer, you will be an important part of the bigger picture working closely with our assembly operations. You will provide technical support and help resolve day-to-day production-related questions and challenges as well as responsibility for the procurement and replacement of equipment.
Your responsibilities include:
Solving problems cross-functionally together with relevant stakeholders, including production, quality, logistics, maintenance, engineering and IT
Procuring and installing new equipment, as well as modifying existing equipment
Challenging and adapting production processes to support the introduction of new or modified products
Leading and delivering improvement projects related to our production processes
Identifying opportunities for improvement, supporting the justification of new investments and contributing to continuous development
Providing technical support to production in daily operations

Who You Are
We believe you are someone who enjoys working in a structured production environment, gains energy from cross-functional collaboration and is motivated by achieving results.
You likely have:
A university degree in engineering or equivalent experience, preferably within industrial, mechanical or electrical engineering
A strong technical interest; experience in production engineering is an advantage
Experience leading or contributing to projects
An interest in IT-related solutions
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

To succeed in this role, you:
Are solution-oriented and enjoy taking on technical challenges
Show drive, initiative and a genuine desire to make a difference
Thrive in a cross-functional environment and build strong working relationships
Take ownership and deliver high-quality results
Work in a structured and analytical way, with a focus on continuous improvement
Communicate clearly and contribute to a positive and collaborative culture

Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 


With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 


Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje. 
Application
Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-24. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
We look forward to your application!

**Specialist Hydroakustik Telekrigstödenheten, MUSAC**

**Telekrigstödenheten (TKSE/Stockholm) är Försvarsmaktens kompetenscentrum inom sensor- och motmedelssystem. TKSE har till uppgift att dataförsörja och analysera information från sensorer, varnar- och motmedelssystem på Försvarsmaktens kvalificerade plattformar. TKSE är en försvarsmaktsgemensam resurs för dataförsörjning av signalkrigplattformar inom alla arenor. MUSAC (Marinens Undervattens-Sensor Analys Central) är den avdelning vid TKSE som ansvarar för analys av hydroakustisk data och produktion av hydroakustiska bibliotek och datasatser.**

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar ett brett ansvar för att analysera och utveckla TKSE:s och MUSAC:s verksamhet och system, både organisatoriskt och metodmässigt. Detta omfattar att stödja avdelningarna i utformningen av arbetsflöden, processer och informationshanteringssystem kopplade till plattforms- och sensorinformation. I rollen ingår även att vidareutveckla metoder och databaser för produktion av hot- och signaturbibliotek, samt att ta fram arbetssätt för hantering av information från hydroakustiska analyser, exempelvis avseende sökalgoritmer, gränssnitt, datafusion och rekonstruktion.

Vidare ansvarar rollen för vidmakthållande och vidareutveckling av befintliga verktyg och system, inklusive kravställning, systemarbete och säkerställande av funktionalitet, såsom för signatur- och referensdatabaser. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar även projektledning vid framtagning av nya verktyg eller system samt systemarbete inom ramen för Systems Engineering, där funktionella krav analyseras och utvecklas.

Därutöver ingår att bistå med tekniskt stöd vid analysarbete, upprätthålla kontakt med FMV och leverantörer samt samordna arbetet med övriga avdelningar inom TKSE, särskilt vad gäller verktygsanvändning, gemensam databearbetning och datafusion.

Arbetet består i huvudsak av komplexa uppgifter där arbetsmetoder och alternativ till lösningar inte är givna eller definierade. Försvarsmakten/TKSE är under stark tillväxt och arbetsuppgifterna kan komma att förändras över tid.

**KRAV**

* Eftergymnasialutbildning som ingenjör med systemteknisk inriktning eller som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.

För att nå befattningens mål är det nödvändigt att ha tillräcklig erfarenhet inom relevanta system- och teknikområden. Kompetensområdet omfattar vitt skilda delar och behöver en djup kompetensnivå där det är nödvändigt att ha flerårig erfarenhet från:

* Svenska marinens ledningsstödsystem, såväl teknisk som taktisk erfarenhet.
* Svenska marinens sensorsystem, avseende främst passiva och aktiva hydroakustiska system, såväl som telekrigsystem.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av den sjöoperativa domänen
* Praktisk erfarenhet av systemarbete (kravanalys och kravformulering) vid anskaffning av militära system.
* Domänkunskap kring plattformar och sensorer (fartyg, flygplan, sonar, radar etc.)
* Utveckling, administration av data i databashanterare (SQL, Filemaker).
* God förmåga av att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.

**Personliga egenskaper**

För att lyckas i rollen som specialist på Telekrigstödenheten krävs en god samarbetsförmåga, att du är lösningsorienterad, arbetar strukturerat, kan vara stabil och trygg i olika sammanhang samt är målmedveten. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

**MERITERANDE**

* Erfarenhet inom projektarbete, projektledning.
* Kunskap och erfarenhet inom Systems Engineering (SE), modellbaserad förmågeutveckling (MBSE).
* Kunskap om Försvarsmaktens och FMV processer inom materielanskaffning.
* Försvarsmaktens processer vid produktion av hot- och signaturbibliotek.
* Bearbetning av data för den svenska marinens informationssystem inom områdena sonardata, ledningssystemdata, orderdata, händelsedata och emitterdata.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med utveckling av AI- och ML-stödda arbetsprocesser.

*För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns. Försvarsmaktens värdegrund slår vakt om alla människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på* *www.forsvarsmakten.se**).*

Som ingenjör hos oss är du en viktig del i projektteam där du jobbar med system som stödjer Marinens fartyg i att inhämta, bearbeta, analysera och dela information som är avgörande för att fartygen skall kunna genomföra sina operativa uppgifter. Du får dessutom möjlighet att delta i forskningsstudier och pågående teknikutveckling på området.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm. Resor både in- och utrikes förekommer som en naturlig del av tjänsten.

### **Om dig**

Vi söker dig som är civil – eller högskoleingenjör, systemvetare eller har en för området annan relevant utbildning. Du har erfarenhet av arbete i projektform eller militärt arbete i motsvarande uppdragsform och du har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på såväl svenska som engelska.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Mechanical Engineer
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
Role Summary
Imagine a Lego kit: are you the type of person who feels accomplished after building the model according to the instructions, or do you enjoy reimagining and rebuilding it in new ways? At Customized Trucks, we embrace Scania's modularity to craft innovative solutions tailored to our customers' needs. We utilize the "Lego" concept extensively, and sometimes, we even modify the "Lego bricks" to ensure they fit perfectly together.
Our responsibility spans the development of customized trucks across various domains, including alternative fuels, electrification, and specialized applications such as mining, heavy haulage, and fire trucks. Every project we undertake begins with a direct customer request, ensuring that our solutions are precisely aligned with their unique requirements.
Job Responsibilities
The tasks we handle range from routine adaptations, which you can process several times a week, to complex solutions that may require extensive projects. This broad scope and varying complexity offer endless opportunities for you to develop your skills and grow. No two weeks will ever be the same!
Your main responsibilities will include:
• Conducting technical investigations of customer requests. When an order is placed, you will describe the adaptation in the product description system and on drawings.
• Product ownership of our special gas solutions and ensuring their maintenance over time.
• Participating in development projects and creating new designs for CNG, LNG, and hydrogen trucks as needed.
• Addressing and resolving field quality issues as they arise.
One of the most exciting aspects of our job is the ability to follow a product from the initial customer request all the way to when the truck leaves the production line!
Who You Are To excel in this role, we believe you should be a driven, proactive, and curious individual who isn't afraid to ask questions. You thrive on handling a variety of tasks that may change quickly and enjoy getting hands-on with technical issues when needed. Your positive and enthusiastic attitude makes you a great team player who fosters knowledge sharing and propels the team forward.
We also look for the following qualifications:
• A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, or equivalent work experience.
• Previous experience in S-order is beneficial but not mandatory.
• At least 3 years of experience in product development.
• Fluency in both written and spoken English.
Experience with Scania products, our modular system, and Catia V5 is advantageous. It is also meritorious if you have worked with gas and hydrogen solutions before. This Is Us
Our group within the Customized Trucks department specializes in designing gas trucks, including CNG and LNG, at a complete truck level. Recently, we were also involved in the exciting task of developing customized hydrogen solutions.
We are a team of nine development engineers and one group manager, and we take great pride in our diversity. Our team members come from various gender identities, ages, life experiences, and cultural backgrounds. We foster an open and supportive work environment where we enjoy our work and support each other.
We operate within a value flow, maintaining close contact with other cross-functional teams such as Sales and Marketing, Project Management, Aftermarket, Production, Purchasing, and Certification. This means you will build a broad Scania network from day one!
Scania Offers We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally through a structured development plan and various courses.
Our benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or a wellness allowance, a result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also hosts events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents can enjoy direct access to Södertälje via the Scania Job express buses.
Application Your application should include a CV, cover letter and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2025-10-25. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Sourjya Chowdhury, Group Manager, sourjya.chowdhury@scania.com We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Analytics / BI Engineer till Synsam
jobs.description:
På Synsam har vi en modern dataplattform, en stor nordisk verksamhet och många intressanta problem att lösa. Vi är ett litet Analytics-team, som ingår i Synsams IT-avdelning, där du får stort utrymme att påverka både vad vi bygger och hur vi arbetar. Vi har olika kompetenser, men hjälps åt och arbetar över gränserna när det behövs.
Vi söker en Analytics / BI Engineer som tycker lika mycket om att förstå verksamhetens problem som att själv utveckla lösningarna. Här får du testa idéer, ta ansvar och se hur dina analyser och lösningar används i verksamheten.
Om rollen
Du kommer att arbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå deras behov, undersöka data och utveckla analyser som används i det dagliga arbetet. Ibland handlar det om att bygga en rapport, ibland om att undersöka varför ett nyckeltal förändrats eller hitta ett bättre sätt att lösa ett problem. 
Rollen kombinerar analys och utveckling. Du arbetar med SQL och data i Snowflake, utvecklar Qlik-appar och skapar visualiseringar och andra analyslösningar. Qlik Cloud är vår huvudsakliga plattform för BI och rapportering. 
Vi arbetar för att samla affärslogik och gemensamma definitioner i dataplattformen, så att de kan återanvändas i olika lösningar. Samtidigt moderniserar vi befintliga rapporter och vill göra det enklare för verksamheten att själv hitta svar i data. I rollen ingår också en del förvaltning och support. 
En viktig del av arbetet är att diskutera med verksamheten, ställa frågor och ibland utmana en beställning. Vi vill förstå vilket problem som ska lösas och vilka beslut informationen ska stödja, snarare än att automatiskt bygga den rapport som efterfrågas.
Efter 12–18 månader har du till exempel:
moderniserat flera av våra centrala Qlik-appar och flyttat affärslogik till dataplattformen


etablerat ett nära samarbete med några verksamhetsområden och hjälpt dem att definiera och äga sina nyckeltal


byggt lösningar som gör att användare själva hittar svar, så att ad hoc-frågor och support minskar


automatiserat återkommande manuella flöden

Vem söker vi?
Vi tror att du har:

Erfarenhet av både analys och utveckling av BI-lösningar.


Goda kunskaper i SQL och förståelse för datamodellering.


Erfarenhet av Qlik eller liknande BI-plattformar.


Förmåga att förstå verksamhetsproblem, utveckla användbara lösningar och följa upp hur de används.


Ett analytiskt arbetssätt och intresse för att undersöka data och dra slutsatser.


Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med både verksamheten och andra tekniska team. 


Erfarenhet av Qlik Cloud, Snowflake och dbt är meriterande, liksom erfarenhet från en prenumerations- eller abonnemangsbaserad verksamhet. 
Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, tycker om att förstå varför saker händer och vågar ifrågasätta invanda arbetssätt. Du är bekväm med att diskutera med verksamheten, förklara dina slutsatser och tillsammans med andra hitta lösningar på problem.
Känner du igen dig i rollen men uppfyller inte alla krav? Sök ändå. Vi är mer intresserade av hur du tänker och vad du kan bidra med än av att du bockar av varje punkt.
Hur vi arbetar
AI är en naturlig del av vårt arbete. Vi använder bland annat Snowflake Cortex Code, ChatGPT och Claude Code för att utveckla, analysera och automatisera. Vi testar nya verktyg och arbetssätt och väljer det som passar uppgiften bäst. 
Vi delar kunskap och förbättrar våra arbetssätt tillsammans. Det viktiga är inte vilket verktyg vi använder, utan kvaliteten på det vi bygger och vad vi åstadkommer. 
Vår huvudsakliga teknikmiljö består idag av Snowflake, dbt, Qlik Cloud och Fivetran.
Om rekryteringsprocessen
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning och utgår från Synsams huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm.
I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll för slutkandidat. För anställning krävs att du har giltig rätt att arbeta i Sverige i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning. Urval sker löpande och vi ser fram emot din ansökan redan idag!
Om Synsam
Synsam Group är en ledande optikerkedja i Norden med ett brett och prisvärt abonnemangs-erbjudande. Synsam Group erbjuder ett brett sortiment av produkter och tjänster för ögonhälsa och ögonmode utifrån kundens olika livsstilar och behov. Koncernen har cirka 4 000 medarbetare, en omsättning på cirka 7,1 miljarder SEK (2025) och har cirka 600 butiker i Norden som drivs under varumärkena Synsam, Synsam Outlet samt Profil Optik i Danmark. Genom digitalisering, abonnemangserbjudanden och andra innovativa koncept är Synsam Group en stark innovatör på den nordiska optikmarknaden inom flera områden, inklusive kundresa, produkterbjudande och ESG. Synsam Groups aktie handlas på Nasdaq Stockholm (SYNSAM). www.synsam.com

jobs.title: SoMe-specialist
jobs.description:
Paid social-specialist med helhetsansvar
– som redan har tre idéer på hur den här annonsen borde ha targetats
Du läste rubriken. Och direkt dök frågorna upp: Varför stannade jag? Vad var det som fångade mig? Och hur hade jag gjort det annorlunda?
Du hann bygga en hel kampanjstruktur i huvudet innan du ens scrollat klart.
Perfekt. Det är precis dig vi letar efter.
Vem är du?
Du är en SoMe-specialist med tyngdpunkt i paid social. Du förstår att annonsering i sociala medier handlar om mer än att trycka ut budget. Det handlar om rätt budskap, till rätt målgrupp, i rätt format, och om att veta varför något fungerade när det fungerade. Du kombinerar kreativ höjd med affärsförståelse och du vet att en kampanj som inte driver något framåt inte håller i längden, hur snygg den än är.
Du har jobbat med paid social i en professionell kontext, gärna från byrå. Du är trygg i Meta Ads Manager och gärna även i LinkedIn Campaign Manager och TikTok Ads. Du vet hur en kontostruktur ska byggas, hur du sätter upp tester som faktiskt går att dra slutsatser av, och hur du optimerar mot ett affärsmål snarare än mot billiga klick. Du förstår också att spelplanen skiljer sig åt mellan plattformarna, att en B2B-kund med lång säljcykel på LinkedIn kräver ett annat tänk än en e-handel på Meta.
Du håller koll på hur plattformarna förändras och du gillar när kreativitet och data möts.
Att du har känsla för content är ett stort plus, eftersom kreativet ofta är det som avgör utfallet. Men tyngdpunkten i rollen ligger på annonseringen.
Och eftersom du, precis som vi, uppskattar struktur: här är en lista på vad vi tror att du har med dig.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med paid social i en professionell kontext, gärna från byrå
Vana vid Meta Ads, och gärna LinkedIn Ads och TikTok Ads, från uppsättning och struktur till optimering och skalning
Förståelse för målgrupper, budgivning, budget och testupplägg
Vana att arbeta med mätning, spårning och uppföljning, och att omsätta siffror till beslut
Förståelse för hur sociala medier kopplas till affärsmål och tillväxt, både i B2C och B2B
God känsla för vad som fungerar kreativt i flödet, i copy, tempo och storytelling
Ett strukturerat arbetssätt kombinerat med kreativ höjd
Nyfikenhet på nya format, plattformar, verktyg och AI

Extra plus om du även:
Själv kan skapa och redigera content, främst foto och video för mobil
Har vana vid organiskt arbete med strategi, contentplaner och publicering
Har haft kundansvar eller arbetat nära kunder tidigare

Vad du kommer att göra
Hos oss får du ett brett helhetsansvar för våra kunders annonsering i sociala medier. Du arbetar med allt från strategi och kampanjupplägg till kreativa koncept, optimering och analys. Du är kundens naturliga kontakt i SoMe-frågor och du jobbar nära övriga specialister i teamet.
Mer konkret innebär det att du:
Ansvarar för flera kunders paid social, från strategi till löpande optimering
Bygger kampanjstrukturer, målgrupper och testupplägg i Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads och TikTok Ads
Tar fram annonskoncept och briefar eller producerar kreativt material
Testar, analyserar, optimerar och skalar det som fungerar
Följer upp resultat och drar insikter som leder arbetet framåt
Tänker i målgrupper, beteenden och communities, inte bara räckvidd
Stöttar kunderna i det organiska arbetet där det behövs
Bidrar till att utveckla vårt erbjudande och arbetssätt inom SoMe

Varför Mild?
Vi erbjuder förstås konkurrenskraftig lön, flexibla arbetstider, hybridarbete, tjänstepension och friskvårdsbidrag (5000 kr/år). Du får även schemalagd tid för självstudier och kompetensutveckling, och frihet att forma din roll utifrån dina styrkor. Men det är väl självklarheter i vår mening.
Det vi snarare vill lyfta är vad du faktiskt får jobba med varje dag: en roll med stort eget ansvar, engagerade kunder och ett team med spetskompetenser inom SEO, SEM, SoMe, CRO, content och strategi. En vardag där kreativitet och affär går hand i hand.
Är du redo att ta helhetsansvaret? Då är Mild lika rätt för dig som du är för Mild.
Låter det intressant?
Kul! Skicka in ditt CV och några rader om dig själv. Har du exempel på kampanjer, konton eller resultat du jobbat med delar du gärna det också.
Vi intervjuar löpande.

Vi söker dig som snabbt kan omvandla en idé eller ett verksamhetsbehov till en fungerande applikation och som ligger sömnlös på nätterna på grund av alla outnyttjade möjligheter här i världen att kunna arbeta snabbare och smartare. 
SkyTech har en ambition om att alltid ligga i framkant och att “skriva boken” snarare än att kopiera andra. Vi är ett snabbfotat företag med korta beslutsvägar, där allt är möjligt. En perfekt miljö för den som är nyfiken, kvick och med en verktygslåda full av AI. 
Vad kommer du att göra? 
Du kommer att arbeta med alla delar av verksamheten för att förstå utmaningar/möjligheter, för att sedan implementera smartare sätt att lösa dessa. 
Det kan exempelvis handla om att: 
bygga interna verktyg och applikationer 
automatisera manuella och tidskrävande arbetsflöden 
koppla ihop olika system genom API:er 
skapa AI-baserade funktioner och tjänster som gör livet lättare för våra kunder 
utforska nya AI-verktyg och hitta sätt att använda dem i verksamheten 

Du kommer sällan få en färdig kravspecifikation. Uppdragen startar oftast med att någon säger: "Det här tar mycket tid och är krångligt" eller “borde inte våra kunder gilla det här?”. 
Därifrån vill vi att du kan ta idén vidare. 
Vi tror att du är en person som 
ser möjligheter där andra ser problem 
gillar att testa nya verktyg och tekniker 
snabbt kan gå från idé till fungerande applikation 
kan arbeta självständigt och driva dina egna projekt 
har erfarenhet av vibe coding och har byggt kompletta applikationer som löser riktiga utmaningar 

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med AI på riktigt och vara med och påverka hur vi använder tekniken i hela verksamheten. 
Om SkyTech 
I dag är SkyTech den bärande grunden för över 20 verksamheter med global närvaro. Kärnverksamheten är samlad inom SignsOnDemand, som finns representerat i över tio länder med fyra produktionsenheter i Europa och USA. Konceptet utvecklas kontinuerligt för att möta nya behov och göra det enklare och snabbare för installatörer och andra yrkesgrupper att beställa kundanpassad märkning och skyltning. 
Parallellt bygger vi Laseronline, där varumärkena StålDirect och ProForger ingår. Här applicerar vi samma grundidé på metall och använder modern teknik för att möjliggöra snabb och effektiv tillverkning av kundanpassade ståldelar. 
Med erfarenheterna från det vi redan har byggt fortsätter SkyTech att utforska nya områden där samma modell kan skapa värde.

jobs.description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com
 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
 
Role Summary
This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden
We are looking for a new team member to join our Cab Durability and Crash simulation unit at TRATON in Sweden. As the transport industry undergoes a major transformation - driven by sustainability, electrification, and autonomy - our group plays a key role in shaping the vehicles of tomorrow.
Our responsibilities span FE strength and fatigue analyses of vehicle cabs, complete-vehicle crash simulations, and the passive safety properties of our vehicles. We also play a key role in vehicle homologation, including compliance with regulations such as UN ECE R29. Together with us, you have a unique opportunity to take an important part in developing TRATON’s future products as well as optimizing the existing ones.
 
Job Responsibilities
As a CAE Engineer, you will be part of a skilled team working at the intersection of simulation, testing, design, and certification. You will have the opportunity to influence product development from early engineering decisions through validation and homologation.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Drive crash safety through simulation. Apply your knowledge of solid mechanics and FE analysis to evaluate structural performance, identify potential improvements, and support designers in developing components and systems that deliver excellent passive safety.
Challenge and improve our methods. Contribute to the continuous development of simulation methodologies, improving predictive capability, efficiency, and turnaround times.
Shape our simulation strategies. Develop load cases, establish product acceptance criteria, and coordinate simulation activities across our global organization.
Connect virtual and physical testing. Work closely with crash test engineers to correlate simulation results with physical tests, understand discrepancies, and develop relevant test methods.
Contribute to vehicle safety and compliance. Support the development and verification of passive safety performance in line with applicable crash safety and homologation requirements.
Collaborate across disciplines. Work closely with designers, testing specialists, certification teams, and international colleagues to turn engineering insights into practical design solutions.

 
Who You Are
You are a curious and analytical engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and translating simulation results into meaningful engineering decisions. You are motivated by the challenge of improving vehicle safety and thrive in an environment where collaboration and technical expertise go hand in hand.
You have:
An MSc or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.
At least two years of experience in passive safety, crash simulation, crash testing, or a related area.
A solid understanding of solid mechanics and finite element analysis, together with the ability to interpret results and translate them into actionable design recommendations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, enabling you to work effectively with designers, technical services, testing teams, and colleagues across different locations.
A proactive mindset and an interest in continuously improving simulation methods, engineering processes, and product performance.

 
It is an advantage if you also have:
Experience with homologation, certification, or regulatory requirements in the automotive or commercial vehicle industry, particularly crash safety.
Practical experience with LS-DYNA and ANSA/Meta.
Familiarity with working in a Linux environment.
